title: Beige: Configuring Auto-Fund Sweeps
summary: Explains how Beige auto-fund sweeps work: set a $50,000 trigger threshold, select eligible connected source/target accounts (max 30 external sources/targets), design rules (top-up to a target vs move only variance), and choose evaluation timing (e.g., end of day). Includes safeguards like dry-run previews and post-enable reconciliation to confirm movements match the rule logic.
faqs: How do I set the auto-fund sweep trigger threshold in Beige?
How many eligible external source/target accounts can I use for sweep rules?
What sweep rule options are available: top up to a target amount or move only the variance?
How do I choose when the sweep evaluates (e.g., end of day)?
Is there a way to preview sweep transfers before executing them?
After enabling sweeps, what should I verify to ensure balances reconcile correctly?
